resources.string: Optional and off by default. During a running focus session, selected apps return you to Home. Your garden is never lost.
ScreenGarden, Home, Settings and calling apps stay available. You can stop focus or turn blocking off at any time.
Android permission is on. Choose whether to enable blocking below.
Android permission is off. Apps will not be blocked.
Choose Block, Always allow, or Normal for each app. Always allow wins over a block. Changes apply to the current session. Each list holds up to 256 apps.
No matching apps. Calling apps and escape routes are excluded from this list.
Android can delay app-opening events. Blocking is a voluntary aid, not a security barrier. It stops when the timer ends. Removing Android permission also stops it.

Android may show broad accessibility warnings. ScreenGarden requests only app-opening events to return blocked apps to Home during focus. Screen-content retrieval is disabled. The service does not read screen text, views or passwords. Events and observed app names are never stored, logged or uploaded. Granting this permission does not enable blocking until you turn the separate switch on.
Could not read or save your choices. Try again. A failed save does not enable blocking.
